scenarios.title: Public property discovery
scenarios.objective: Open {{base_url}}. Click 'Explore properties' in the top navigation and verify the heading 'Find your place.' is visible and the result count shows 'PROPERTIES'. Click the 'Buy' tab in the listing toolbar and verify at least one property card with a price in Naira (₦) is shown. Click 'View details' on the first card and verify a dialog opens showing a disclaimer that tells the visitor to independently confirm documents or not to send money.
scenarios.summary:
You asked to explore property listings, switch to homes for sale, and open the first listing’s details.
Opened the property directory from the top navigation, where the “Find your place.” heading and property results were displayed.
Selected the Buy tab; property cards appeared with Naira pricing, including ₦185,000,000.
Opened the first listing’s details, which displayed a notice advising visitors to independently confirm relevant documents or not send money.
The requested property-browsing flow was completed successfully.

scenarios.title: Landlord creates a draft and cannot submit without evidence
scenarios.objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{landlord_email}} and password {{landlord_password}}. Open 'My listings' and click 'New listing'. Fill the form with title 'Kane test flat in Gwarinpa', listing type Rent, price 4500000, 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, address '12 Test Close, Gwarinpa', city 'Abuja', state 'FCT' and a description of at least 30 characters, then click 'Create draft'. Verify the page heading 'Edit listing.' and a 'Draft' badge are visible. Click 'Submit for review' without uploading anything and verify an error says a photograph or ownership document is required before submitting.
scenarios.summary:
Signed in and opened My listings to start a new property listing.
Created a draft rental listing titled “Kane test flat in Gwarinpa” with the requested price, bedrooms, bathrooms, Abuja address, FCT state, and description.
The listing opened in edit mode and showed a Draft status.
Tried to submit the listing for review without uploading files; the page correctly required at least one photograph or ownership document before submission.

scenarios.title: Verifier queue and decision rules
scenarios.objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{verifier_email}} and password {{verifier_password}}. Open 'Verification queue'. If the text 'The queue is clear' is shown, verify that message. Otherwise click the first listing, verify the buttons 'Approve and verify' and 'Reject' are visible, leave the notes empty, click 'Reject' and verify a message asks for the reason for rejection.
scenarios.summary:
Signed in with the provided account and opened the Verification queue.
The queue was not clear, so the first listing was opened.
Confirmed that “Approve and verify” and “Reject” were available, then selected “Reject” with no notes entered.
Verified that the page asked for a reason for rejection.
